candidate.answerReason: Three daily doublings from 6 units give 6·2^3=48 units.

methods.label: Evaluate the doubling model
methods.explanation: Multiply by 2 each time. Use \(6\times 2^t\); when \(t=3\), the result is 48.
methods.levelReason: The method uses repeated doubling represented by a small positive integer power, followed by multiplication.
